Private Function Ranged(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As ShapeRange, sh As Shape, o As Object, b As Object
    Dim s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 30).Name = "A": Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A"))
    Case 1
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(1, 10, 10): b.AddNodes 0, 0, 110, 10: b.AddNodes 0, 0, 60, 80: b.ConvertToShape.Name = "A": Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A"))
    Case 2
        ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 20, 10).Name = "A": Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A"))
    Case 3
        ws.Shapes.AddCallout(msoCalloutTwo, 10, 10, 40, 30).Name = "A": Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A"))
    Case 4
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 30).Name = "A": ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, 60, 10, 40, 30).Name = "B": Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B"))
    Case 5
        ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 20, 10).Name = "A": ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\a.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 40, 10, 20, 10).Name = "B": ws.Shapes("B").PictureFormat.Brightness = 0.7: Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B"))
    End Select
    Set sh = r(1): Set o = r
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.PictureFormat)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.PictureFormat.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.PictureFormat.CropLeft
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.PictureFormat.ColorType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.PictureFormat.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.Nodes)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.Nodes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Nodes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.Vertices)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = UBound(r.Vertices, 1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.Vertices(1, 1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.Callout)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.Callout.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Callout.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.Callout.AutoAttach
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.TextEffect)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.TextEffect.Text
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.TextEffect)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(r.ThreeD)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.ThreeD.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh.ThreeD)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.ThreeD.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.[_Default](1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = o.[_Default](1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Ranged = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Graphics() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, g As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set g = ws.PageSetup.LeftHeaderPicture
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.ColorType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.Contrast
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.CropBottom
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.CropLeft
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.CropRight
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = g.CropTop
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(g.Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    g.Brightness = 0.6
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.ColorType = msoPictureGrayscale
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.Contrast = 0.6
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.CropBottom = 1
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.CropLeft = 1
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.CropRight = 1
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    g.CropTop = 1
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Graphics = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Trios() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Shape, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 40, 30)
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(sh.Shadow), wb.Name, "<book>")
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(sh.Glow), wb.Name, "<book>")
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(sh.SoftEdge), wb.Name, "<book>")
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(sh.Reflection), wb.Name, "<book>")
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(ws.PageSetup.LeftHeaderPicture), wb.Name, "<book>")
    s = s & "@" & Replace(Trio(ws.PageSetup.CenterFooterPicture), wb.Name, "<book>")
    wb.Close False
    Trios = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Trio(o As Object) As String
    Dim a As String, c As String, p As String, n As String, la As String, lc As String, sp As String
    Dim v As Variant, q As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set q = o.Application
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        a = "e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        a = TypeName(q) & " " & (q Is Application)
    End If
    v = o.Creator
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        c = "e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        c = v & " " & TypeName(v)
    End If
    Set q = Nothing
    Set q = o.Parent
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        p = "e" & Err.Number
        Err.Clear
    Else
        p = TypeName(q)
        If InStr("FillFormat LineFormat Chart", TypeName(q)) = 0 Then n = q.Name
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            n = "e" & Err.Number
            Err.Clear
        End If
    End If
    o.Application = 1
    la = "e" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    o.Creator = 1
    lc = "e" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    Set o.Parent = Application
    sp = "e" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    Trio = a & "~" & c & "~" & p & "~" & n & "~" & la & "~" & lc & "~" & sp
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 5
        s = s & "@@@" & Ranged(i, folder)
    Next
    s = s & "@@@" & Graphics() & "@@@" & Trios()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
